conclusions.dominant_steps: Cannot isolate helper or verification costs from missing endpoints. Interdecision intervals combine classification, callbacks, helper work, model processing and any host suspension.
conclusions.quiet_host_900_seconds: Not established: no complete run, isolated helper duration series or remaining-tail timings. Total pytest time is not attempt duration.
conclusions.recommendation: Quiet-host run arranged by the lead, after issue 6170 fixes dispatch origin and suspend-inclusive timing. Retain entry/dispatch, helper start/end, turn boundaries and host observations. Do not change the synthetic deadline from this evidence.
